tools.name: wallet-intelligence_snapshot
tools.description: Retrieve current wallet balance and supplied token balances on Base Mainnet with USD valuations from DeFiLlama. Token approvals/allowances are not included; use security/approvals before moving funds. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/wallet-intelligence/snapshot. An unpaid call returns the x402 paymen

tools.name: wallet-intelligence_transfers
tools.description: Retrieve ERC-20 transfer activity within a requested block range on Base Mainnet using public JSON-RPC. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/wallet-intelligence/transfers. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Inspect a supplied transaction hash on Base Mainnet with gas analysis and USD cost estimation. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/wallet-intelligence/transaction. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "wallet-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals · Private data: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report · Public sink: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report · Destructive: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals · Private data: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report · Public sink: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report · Destructive: wallet-intelligence_snapshot, wallet-intelligence_transfers, wallet-intelligence_analyze, wallet-intelligence_transaction, wallet-intelligence_security-address, wallet-intelligence_security-approvals, wallet-intelligence_security-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
